source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), this unit may attempt Quickening once while free of Battle-shock. Roll a D6 for the [Psychic ability](vsdata:core-rule/psychic-abilities). A 1 Battle-shocks the unit. If you chose to roll, the unit also gains [Assault Doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines) up to the beginning of your following Command phase, alongside any doctrines already active.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
